problem_statement:
Timeout(connect=5) with a default timeout ignores the default for other phases

```python
>>> t = Timeout(10.0, connect=5.0)
>>> t.read
None
```

Expected `10.0`. When a positional default is given, all unspecified phases should take it.
gold_patch_old: self.read = None if isinstance(read, UnsetType) else read
gold_patch_new: self.read = timeout if isinstance(read, UnsetType) else read
